title: Hazel and the Archive
author: Mara Amberdale
blurb: Rosalind Fairweather, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
